rule: refine -> freeze with dated hash -> test on unseen data. Numbers below are exploratory and are not counted as confirmed predictions.
unseen_data_tests: R1/R4: next PDG review of |V_us| (Kl3/Kmu2 and tau inputs) and the next CKMfitter/UTfit global fit; pass iff z<=1 against the new published sigma.
R2: next superallowed 0+->0+ |V_ud| (Hardy-Towner update) and new K-decay |V_us|: the direct first-row deficit must stay within 1 sigma of 1.644994e-03.
R3: applies only if a future |V_ud| fit-vs-direct separation is re-published; record the verdict before looking at the seed z.

refinements.name: |V_us| route: Quantum_Mechanics -> Chemistry condensation
refinements.statement: |V_us| = theta_S/phi + (1 - S_Chemistry), with theta_S, phi and S_Chemistry the AEB2AD pin values (domain_scalar("Chemistry")); replaces the pin's theta_S/phi + (1 - S_Quantum_Mechanics) for this observable only.
refinements.note: Numerically equal to the pre-FE23A2 (pin 3090BC, Quantum_Mechanics at D=6) closed-form value; FE23A2 moved Quantum_Mechanics to D=5 (hub 3c74a180, 2026-09-11).

refinements.name: CKM first-row deficit term alpha/(pi*sqrt2)
refinements.statement: 1 - (|V_ud|^2 + |V_us|^2 + |V_ub|^2)_direct = alpha_seed / (pi * sqrt(2)), alpha_seed = 1/(phi*G_Catalan/C_factor)^3 (vendor/fsot_seed_flavor.py seed_alpha_inv), evaluated in IEEE double; measured side uses PDG 2024 direct |V_ud| = 0.97367(32), |V_us| = 0.22431(85) and the seed |V_ub|.
refinements.note: alpha_seed here is 1/136.827, not the pin constant ALPHA = 8.08e-4 and not the alpha_inv leaf 137.035999166; the review script calls it alpha_FSOT (naming clash, AUDIT_LOG H-09).

refinements.name: |V_ud| channel_mismatch exemption rule
refinements.statement: A CKM magnitude that passes z<=1 against the PDG 2024 global fit but fails against the direct determination is classified channel_mismatch (no coefficient may be added) iff the published fit-vs-direct separation |fit - direct|/sigma_direct is >= the prediction's own z against the direct value.
refinements.note: Rule, not a number. The scored set compares |V_ud| with the global fit only (the same bar as every other CKM element), so R3 changes no count.

refinements.name: route selection by lowest z
refinements.statement: Among candidate routes for an observable that pass z<=1 against the PDG 2024 global fit, select the one with the lowest z (fsot_precision_kill.py go_to = min(passing, key=z_global_fit)).
refinements.value: selects seed_lambda POOF*(1+ETA_EFF) = 0.225149539041 for |V_us| (candidates: pin_qm_floor z=6.7301, condensation_chemistry z=0.7579, seed_lambda z=0.2052)
refinements.note: The scored set does NOT use this rule. It uses the CKM seed leaf because Damian committed it in scripts/ckm_magnitude_seed_check.py (hub 4c270461, 2026-09-29) before this freeze; it coincides with R4's choice here.
